It took me about 3 weeks to have my first LD. Even though I can not remember it exactly, I needed one more month to regularly have LDs.
Today it is effortless for me, as long as I remember my dreams and stick to a fixed sleeping schedule.
How did you go about teaching yourself to LD?

I practiced my all day awareness. I chose some random actions (looking at my mobile screen, drinking, etc.) and whenever I did any of them, I took my time to look around and check whether it was a dream or not (called reality checks - but always have a critical attitude towards your environment). Autosuggestion ("I will have a lucid dream tonight") before sleeping also helped tremendously. Of course I also read a lot about LD at that time, so it was almost omnipresent in my thoughts. What I did is pretty close to what is described here.
It is probably most important to use a technique which comes natural to one. For example, I can wake up at a certain time (+-2 minutes) after choosing one before falling asleep. I do not think that a technique like this one could ever work out for me, partly because I am not used to going to bed early.
